'''Sindal Reed''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] boss, and the leader of the [[Exchange]]'s spice operation on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] individual working for [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Charles Reskin|Reskin]] in [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="TOR" />
